Most likely loss: insider distribution by the operator cluster. The launch was bundled: top-5 buyers hold 99.7% of the first two minutes' volume, 521 SOL came in from 17 external buyers, and the bundle share and top3 share are both 1.0. The completer share of 2.87 means a single wallet's activity dominates the curve. A launch bot was present, and sell-to-buy in the first two minutes is 0.0001, so early sellers were essentially absent while insiders accumulated.

The last 15 minutes show the operator starting to exit: 8.22 SOL sold against 9.86 bought, net flow of only 1.64 SOL, and 28 sellers against 42 buyers. The 30-minute return is just 5.75%, and the drawdown from the high is near zero, so the price is pinned rather than trending.

At a $20 ticket, the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost would absorb a small move, and a sudden dump by a bundle holding nearly all supply would be far larger. Skip.
